title: Pegasus Crew
author: Dildemma / Emma Capion Avnbøl
description:
Captain Astrid and her Pegasus Crew enter the pleasure moon-park Eudaimonia with one mission: to recover her lost purpose.

The choices you make as you venture through Pleasure Gardens and Entertainment Districts determine the relationship with your companions and your crew's fate.

What kind of Captain will you be?

Content warning: Mild sexual themes, discriminatory content
